description_excerpt: Job Description MEP Engineer – Building & Infrastructure (B&I) is responsible for site inspection and supervision of Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing and Fire Protection works to verify compliance with approved designs, specifications, method statements, inspection plans, statutory requirements and SGS quality standards. The role supports the Project Manager in coordinating contractors, monitoring MEP quality/progress, managing inspection records, witnessing testing and commissioning activities, and reporting non-conformances to ensure safe, compliant and effective project delivery.…
